description: Figure 10 is a line plot illustrating the model’s evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL) as a function of the activated parameters ratio (%) for different configurations of sparsity applied to the Attention and Feed-Forward Network (FFN) components. The x-axis, labeled “Activated Parameters Ratio(%)”, is displayed in reverse order, ranging from 100% on the left to 25% on the right, with major tick marks at 100, 75, 50, and 25. The y-axis, labeled “Eval PPL”, ranges from 11.5 to 14.0, with major tick marks at intervals of 0.5. Four distinct lines are plotted: a red dashed line for “Transformer”, a gray square-marked line for “Only MoHD FFN”, a blue circle-marked line for “Only MoHD ATTN”, and a cyan cross-marked line for “MoHD ATTN + MLP”. The “Transformer” baseline remains nearly flat, hovering around 11.5 across all sparsity levels. The “Only MoHD FFN” line starts at approximately 11.5 at 100% activation, dips slightly to around 11.4 at 75%, then rises gradually to about 11.8 at 25%. The “Only MoHD ATTN” line begins at 11.5, increases to 12.0 at 75%, then climbs steeply to 14.0 at 25%. The “MoHD ATTN + MLP” line starts at 11.5, rises to 12.0 at 75%, and continues to increase to approximately 13.2 at 25%.
